name: islamic-finance-router
description: Routes Islamic finance queries to the correct product skill and jurisdiction overlay. Activate for any query involving Islamic banking, AAOIFI, Shariah- compliant finance, sukuk, takaful, murabaha, ijarah, musharaka, mudaraba, salam, istisna'a, zakat, or Shariah screening. Covers 20 jurisdictions across 3 accounting regimes (AAOIFI-primary, IFRS with Islamic guidance, local standards).
